passages.text: An empty room beside our library has almost no chairs or shelves. Our class wants it to become a reading space for younger pupils. Each family offers one useful thing, such as a cushion or a small table. We draw a plan before placing anything, leaving a clear path to the door. Mia labels the book boxes while Ben checks where the lamps can stand. When everything is in place, the younger pupils choose books and try the new seats. The room changes because many people share a small amount of work.

parallelText.en: An empty room beside our library has almost no chairs or shelves.
parallelText.zh: 图书馆旁有一间空房，几乎没有椅子和架子。

parallelText.en: Our class wants it to become a reading space for younger pupils.
parallelText.zh: 我们班希望它变成低年级学生的阅读空间。

parallelText.en: Each family offers one useful thing, such as a cushion or a small table.
parallelText.zh: 每个家庭提供一件实用品，比如靠垫或小桌子。

parallelText.en: We draw a plan before placing anything, leaving a clear path to the door.
parallelText.zh: 我们放东西前先画规划，留出通向门的畅通小路。

parallelText.en: Mia labels the book boxes while Ben checks where the lamps can stand.
parallelText.zh: 米娅给书箱贴标签，本检查台灯可以放在哪里。

parallelText.en: When everything is in place, the younger pupils choose books and try the new seats.
parallelText.zh: 一切就位后，低年级学生选书并试坐新座位。

parallelText.en: The room changes because many people share a small amount of work.
parallelText.zh: 许多人分担少量工作，让房间变了样。

wordHelp.meaning: a soft pad used to make a seat more comfortable
things such as chairs, tables and shelves

passages.text: Our teacher brings leaves and small stones to the art room. She asks us to draw their natural shapes instead of making every line perfect. At the sight of a leaf with an uneven edge, Ben begins to notice tiny details. He sees that one side is wider and that several holes let light through. Mia chooses a stone and uses several colours to show its marks. We compare the drawings and see that close looking matters more than matching a perfect shape.

parallelText.en: Our teacher brings leaves and small stones to the art room.
parallelText.zh: 老师把叶子和小石头带到美术室。

parallelText.en: She asks us to draw their natural shapes instead of making every line perfect.
parallelText.zh: 她请我们画它们天然的形状，而不把每条线都画得完美。

parallelText.en: At the sight of a leaf with an uneven edge, Ben begins to notice tiny details.
parallelText.zh: 看见一片边缘不规则的叶子时，本开始注意细小特征。

parallelText.en: He sees that one side is wider and that several holes let light through.
parallelText.zh: 他发现一侧更宽，还有几个孔能透光。

parallelText.en: Mia chooses a stone and uses several colours to show its marks.
parallelText.zh: 米娅选了一块石头，用几种颜色表现上面的痕迹。

parallelText.en: We compare the drawings and see that close looking matters more than matching a perfect shape.
parallelText.zh: 我们比较画作，发现仔细观察比模仿完美形状更重要。

wordHelp.meaning: not smooth, straight or equal
the outer line of an object
